_comment: Bellevue 116th camera with the Li et al. (2025 TITS) derived mechanisms:
E5 over-saturation measurement  - always on once a demand vector flows (no flag)
E6 use_gap_out                  - end GREEN when the queue clears, extend while it persists
E3 use_discharge_green          - green = queue/sat_flow + lost_time (Li Eq. 7)
E7 stop counting                - always measured, reported in the run log
min_green_time is 5 s and max 60 s so gap-out has room to act: the queue at this
junction clears in a few seconds, so a 30 s floor would hide the whole effect.
saturation_flow_rate 0.5 PCE/s = 1800 PCE/h, the conventional per-lane value, and
the lost time charged per phase is the 3 s yellow_duration (Li Eq. 7 T_loss).
No new weights are introduced: E5/E6/E7 decide by measured comparison, not by a
tuned coefficient, which is the design principle taken from Li et al.'s critique
of hyperparameter-heavy models. Geometry, alpha, saturation counts and queue
capacities are copied unchanged from config/bellevue_116th.json.
